evidence: Home page grid shows 6 templates each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), description, category, scenario, usage count, updated date
Each card in browser_snapshot shows title, category badge, scenario badge, description paragraph, author name, usage count, and 'Updated' date
Clicking Use Template on Professional Resume opened preview panel with Fill Template/Preview Result tabs, template title, and full field list
All 14 fields (name, title, email, phone, summary, company, position, startDate, endDate, responsibilities, degree, school, graduationYear, skills) accepted input values
After filling all required fields, Preview Result tab enabled and shows generated resume with all entered values substituted (Jane Doe, Software Engineer, Tech Corp, etc.)

Preview rendered proper Markdown: h1 name, h2 headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), h3 subheading, strong/emphasis text, separator line, all placeholders replaced with actual values
Preview Result tab was disabled and 'Required fields missing' message shown while fields blank; became enabled and showed rendered result only after every required field was filled

Before filling fields, panel showed 'Required fields missing Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills' and Preview Result tab was disabled
Clicking 'Copy to Clipboard' showed toast 'Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied.' and navigator.clipboard.readText() returned the Markdown-formatted result matching preview
Markdown template (Professional Resume) rendered proper headings, bold, italics, separator after field substitution; will verify plain-text template separately

issue: Email field does not validate format
actual: Entered 'not-an-email' into the required Email field on Professional Resume template; no inline validation error appeared, and Preview Result tab remained enabled and generated content containing the invalid, unformatted email text verbatim ('...not-an-email...') instead of rejecting it or keeping preview unavailable

issue: Special Markdown characters in field values are not neutralized
actual: Entered '# Injected Heading\n---\n**Bold Attack**' into the Full Name field; the rendered preview interpreted the embedded '**Bold Attack**' as literal Markdown and rendered it as bold text inside the H1, instead of escaping/rejecting the special characters and displaying them as plain literal text

issue: 'Oldest First' sort produces the same order as 'Recently Updated' instead of the reverse
actual: Category filter (Resume -> 'Showing 1 of 6') and Scenario filter (Academic -> 'Showing 1 of 6') worked correctly, and Alphabetical sort correctly ordered titles A-Z. However selecting 'Oldest First' produced the exact same order as 'Recently Updated' (Professional Email 12-05, Professional Resume 12-01, Weekly Status Report 11-28, Meeting Minutes 11-15, Project Proposal 10-20, Academic Research Summary 09-30) instead of the reverse (oldest-updated first)

evidence: Category filter, scenario filter, and sort selections all updated visible result count and card order immediately in place with no page navigation/reload observed

Typing 'Res' (3 chars) showed real-time suggestions (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, In Progress, Academic Research Summary, Research Title); clicking 'Professional Resume' filled search box with 'Professional Resume' and narrowed grid to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates'

actual: Typing 'Resme' (a one-letter typo of 'Resume') produced no suggestions and 'No templates found' / 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' instead of returning or suggesting the intended 'Professional Resume' template

evidence: Clicking favorite toggle on Professional Resume immediately switched its state to 'on', updated header 'Favorites' toggle label to 'Favorites 1' and favorites.count observable to '1'
Favorited Professional Resume and Meeting Minutes via card toggle; clicking header 'Favorites' toggle opened a favorites-only list showing exactly those 2 templates ('Showing 2 of 6 templates')
While in favorites-only view (2 favorites), typing 'Meeting' in search narrowed results to 'Showing 1 of 6 templates' showing only Meeting Minutes, confirming search works within favorites-only mode
Submit Template dialog accepted title, author, description, category, scenario, Markdown content with {{name}}/{{role}} placeholders, and two defined fields (Name, Role); submission succeeded

After submission, 'QA Test Template' appeared in library grid (7 of 7 templates); selecting it via 'Use Template' opened its form with Name and Role fields, which could be filled and previewed successfully

Both 'Name' and 'Role' fields were added independently via the Add Field control and both remained individually fillable in the resulting form (verified values Alex Kim / QA Engineer applied to their respective fields)
Immediately after clicking Submit Template, result count updated from 'Showing 6 of 6' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' with the new template visible, with no page reload/navigation observed

Submitting a completely blank form showed 'Missing required fields / Please fill in all required fields' and did not add a template; submitting a form with title/author/description/content filled but zero defined fields showed 'No fields defined / Please add at least one template field' and result count stayed at 7 of 7 (unchanged)

After navigating to the app URL again (reload), favorites count remained 2 with Professional Resume and Meeting Minutes still marked favorite ('on'), and the custom 'QA Test Template' submitted earlier still appeared in the grid ('Showing 7 of 7 templates')
